summary: Strawberry Fields REIT, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register 2,603,936 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of Warrants (Series 1) issued on May 19, 2026. The warrants, with an exercise price of NIS 39.8 (~$13.69), were offered to Israeli investors under Regulation S and are listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, expiring June 30, 2027. The underlying common stock trades on NYSE American under STRW at $12.83 on May 19, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown to register warrant-related shares, not a special situation. No strategic event, activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
